# OmniaUI

> OmniaUI is the component and block library for OmniaCSS: 145 components and
> 85 page blocks (dashboards, auth, pricing, marketing …) as plain HTML with oc-* classes, plus
> wrappers for React, Vue, Laravel Blade and Livewire. Behaviour comes from native HTML (dialog, popover, details,
> :has(), anchor positioning), so most components need no JavaScript. Free and MIT licensed; 39 advanced
> blocks are part of OmniaUI Pro (paid license).

Current version: 0.12.4.

## Rules for AI assistants

- Use the reference markup of a component instead of writing one from scratch: the classes, ARIA attributes and
  structure matter (a modal is <dialog class="oc-modal"> opened with command="show-modal" commandfor="id").
- OmniaUI classes start with oc- (oc-btn, oc-card, oc-modal). Layout and spacing around them use OmniaCSS utilities,
  which are NOT Tailwind: read https://omniacss.eu/llms.txt.
- Colors come from theme tokens (--oc-primary, --oc-background, --oc-foreground, --oc-border …) that switch with light
  and dark mode via light-dark(). Do not hard-code colors on components.
- Blocks marked (Pro) need an OmniaUI Pro license; their markup is not public. Suggest a free block or component instead
  unless the project has @birdycom/omniaui-pro installed.
- The MCP server gives the exact markup of every component and block: claude mcp add omniacss -- npx -y @birdycom/omniacss-mcp

## Install

npm (with OmniaCSS):
  npm install @birdycom/omniacss @birdycom/omniaui @birdycom/omniaui-blocks
  /* CSS entry */ @import "@birdycom/omniaui"; @import "@birdycom/omniaui-blocks";
Add one component or block to the project as HTML, React, Vue or Blade:
  npx omniaui add modal
  npx omniaui add pricing --framework react
React: npm install @birdycom/omniaui-react   (import { Button, Modal } from "@birdycom/omniaui-react")
Vue:   npm install @birdycom/omniaui-vue     (import { OcButton, OcModal } from "@birdycom/omniaui-vue")
Laravel:
  composer require birdycom/omniaui-laravel && php artisan omniacss:install
  <x-oc::button variant="primary">Save</x-oc::button>   <x-oc::block.app-shell>…</x-oc::block.app-shell>
Livewire: composer require birdycom/omniaui-livewire

## Components

- [Button](https://omniaui.eu/ui/components/button): Buttons: default, secondary, outline, ghost, destructive and sizes
- [Modal / Dialog](https://omniaui.eu/ui/components/modal): Modal on <dialog> — opens with invoker commands, no JavaScript
- [Data table](https://omniaui.eu/ui/components/data-table): Card with title, actions, search toolbar, sortable table, bulk bar and pagination footer
- [Accordion](https://omniaui.eu/ui/components/accordion): Exclusive accordion on <details name> — no JavaScript
- [Accordion accent](https://omniaui.eu/ui/components/accordion-accent): Accordion variant: every item is a card with a colored accent edge; presets or semantic colors per item - no JavaScript
- [Affix input](https://omniaui.eu/ui/components/affix-input): Input with an inline prefix or suffix symbol (currency, percent, email)
- [Alert](https://omniaui.eu/ui/components/alert): Alerts: info, success, warning, danger
- [Alert dialog](https://omniaui.eu/ui/components/alert-dialog): Confirmation modal with a status icon (success, error, warning, info, question)
- [Alpha tabs](https://omniaui.eu/ui/components/alpha-tabs): All + A-Z letter filter bar for long lists; scrolls sideways on small screens
- [Aspect ratio](https://omniaui.eu/ui/components/aspect-ratio): Aspect-ratio box with presets and fill behaviour for img/video/iframe
- [Attachment](https://omniaui.eu/ui/components/attachment): File chip and image preview for chat messages and composers: icon by type, name, size, remove and upload states
- [Avatar](https://omniaui.eu/ui/components/avatar): Avatars and avatar group
- [Back link](https://omniaui.eu/ui/components/back-link): Outline link that names its destination (Back to Products)
- [Badge](https://omniaui.eu/ui/components/badge): Badges
- [Barcode input](https://omniaui.eu/ui/components/barcode-input): Barcode / EAN field with a preview area below it
- [Breadcrumb](https://omniaui.eu/ui/components/breadcrumb): Breadcrumb
- [Browser frame](https://omniaui.eu/ui/components/browser-frame): Fake browser chrome around a screenshot or live content
- [Busy overlay](https://omniaui.eu/ui/components/busy-overlay): Modal "please wait" overlay while a long form submit or upload runs
- [Button group](https://omniaui.eu/ui/components/button-group): Joined buttons with shared borders: horizontal, vertical, text addon
- [Calendar](https://omniaui.eu/ui/components/calendar): Calendar: month grid markup with selected, today, range and outside-day states
- [Card](https://omniaui.eu/ui/components/card): Card with header, content, footer
- [Carousel](https://omniaui.eu/ui/components/carousel): Carousel: CSS scroll-snap with ::scroll-button arrows and ::scroll-marker dots, fallback links
- [Chart tokens](https://omniaui.eu/ui/components/chart): Chart tokens --oc-chart-1..5 (light-dark Omnia colors) with legend, bar and pie helpers
- [Chat composer](https://omniaui.eu/ui/components/chat-composer): Chat message field with a toolbar and a send button in one frame
- [Checklist](https://omniaui.eu/ui/components/checklist): Rule / step list with met and unmet states (password rules, onboarding)
- [Chip filter](https://omniaui.eu/ui/components/chip-filter): Rounded filter chips (checkboxes for several, radios for one) - no JavaScript
- [Code block](https://omniaui.eu/ui/components/code)
- [Code window](https://omniaui.eu/ui/components/code-window): Code window with title bar and copy-to-clipboard button on the Code block
- [Collapsible section](https://omniaui.eu/ui/components/collapsible): Card-style details/summary form section with icon, title and chevron
- [Color field](https://omniaui.eu/ui/components/color-field): Native color picker next to a hex text input
- [Color select](https://omniaui.eu/ui/components/color-select): Pick one color from round swatches (or a list with names)
- [Column menu](https://omniaui.eu/ui/components/column-menu): Column visibility checklist in a popover; hides table columns with :has() - no JavaScript
- [Combobox](https://omniaui.eu/ui/components/combobox): Combobox: input + listbox styling (filtering and selection are wrapper responsibility)
- [Command](https://omniaui.eu/ui/components/command): Command palette / searchable list styling (filter logic in a wrapper)
- [Confirm dialog](https://omniaui.eu/ui/components/confirm-dialog): Alert dialog variant: icon ring, close button, typed confirmation and a discard action - no JavaScript
- [Context menu](https://omniaui.eu/ui/components/context-menu): Context menu: dropdown menu at the pointer with a minimal documented script
- [Cookie consent](https://omniaui.eu/ui/components/cookie-consent): Cookie banner with categories on popover="manual"; a small script remembers the choice
- [Copy field](https://omniaui.eu/ui/components/copy-field): Read-only monospace value with a copy button
- [Counter](https://omniaui.eu/ui/components/counter): Animated number (@property) — starts when scrolled into view
- [Date picker](https://omniaui.eu/ui/components/date-picker): Date picker: trigger button with a calendar popover, or a native date input
- [Decimal input](https://omniaui.eu/ui/components/decimal-input): Text field for locale decimals like 1.234,56, with an optional unit
- [Definition list](https://omniaui.eu/ui/components/definition-list): Label / value rows in a panel (dl)
- [Demo panel](https://omniaui.eu/ui/components/demo-panel): Demo panel: live preview and code, stacked or as CSS-only tabs
- [Document viewer](https://omniaui.eu/ui/components/doc-viewer): PDF, video or image in a card with a label and a full-screen view on a native <dialog>
- [Drawer](https://omniaui.eu/ui/components/drawer): Drawer: bottom sheet on dialog with drag handle look, no JavaScript
- [Dropdown](https://omniaui.eu/ui/components/dropdown): Dropdown menu on popover + anchor positioning — no JavaScript
- [Dropdown menu extras](https://omniaui.eu/ui/components/dropdown-menu): Dropdown extras: sub-menus, checkbox and radio items, shortcuts, destructive/disabled items
- [Dropzone](https://omniaui.eu/ui/components/dropzone): File upload target - a label around a real file input
- [Emoji picker](https://omniaui.eu/ui/components/emoji-picker): Compact popover grid of emoji buttons, anchored to its trigger
- [Empty state](https://omniaui.eu/ui/components/empty-state): Icon, title, text and actions for lists without data
- [Entity card](https://omniaui.eu/ui/components/entity-card): Framed media cell (image, glyph, icon) next to a detail column with facts
- [Expandable table and toggle button](https://omniaui.eu/ui/components/expandable-table): Table with CSS-only Show more / Show less and a reusable toggle button variant
- [Fact list](https://omniaui.eu/ui/components/fact-list): Key / value product facts in a card, a variant of the definition list
- [Filter counts](https://omniaui.eu/ui/components/filter-counts): View filter tiles with counts (active / deleted / all) - no JavaScript
- [Flip card](https://omniaui.eu/ui/components/flip-card): 3D flip card (front / back) on a checkbox toggle or on hover and focus
- [Forms & Inputs](https://omniaui.eu/ui/components/forms)
- [Glass](https://omniaui.eu/ui/components/glass): See-through glass sheet and panels with a light top edge, for widgets and panels over a photo, a gradient or the desktop
- [Greeting](https://omniaui.eu/ui/components/greeting): Dashboard header with a time-of-day greeting, the date and actions
- [Heading](https://omniaui.eu/ui/components/heading): Page or section title with a muted description
- [Hover card](https://omniaui.eu/ui/components/hover-card): Hover card: preview on hover/focus via interestfor + popover, CSS hover fallback
- [Image zoom](https://omniaui.eu/ui/components/image-zoom): Zoom and pan viewport with CSS-only zoom levels
- [Item](https://omniaui.eu/ui/components/item): Item: list row with media, content and actions
- [Kbd](https://omniaui.eu/ui/components/kbd): Keyboard key and shortcut group
- [Label](https://omniaui.eu/ui/components/label): Form label: block, inline (around a control), required mark, muted
- [Language select](https://omniaui.eu/ui/components/language-select): Compact language or currency switcher for a site header
- [Launcher card](https://omniaui.eu/ui/components/launcher-card): Large clickable card with icon, title and description (module hub, settings sections)
- [Lightbox](https://omniaui.eu/ui/components/lightbox): Image viewer on a native <dialog> with prev / next, counter and caption
- [Line and area chart](https://omniaui.eu/ui/components/chart-line): Line and area chart in inline SVG with axes, legend and tooltips on hover and focus
- [Link arrow](https://omniaui.eu/ui/components/link-arrow): Text link with an arrow that moves on hover and focus
- [Link row](https://omniaui.eu/ui/components/link-row): A row of links under a feature card, with an external icon and the GitHub mark by themselves
- [List toolbar](https://omniaui.eu/ui/components/list-toolbar): Search, result count, cards / table view toggle and actions above a list; the toggle switches views with :has() - no JavaScript
- [Live frame](https://omniaui.eu/ui/components/live-frame): A live page at a virtual size such as 1280x720, scaled down to the frame width without JavaScript
- [Marquee](https://omniaui.eu/ui/components/marquee): Endless scrolling strip of chips; pauses on hover and focus, static with reduced motion
- [Media card](https://omniaui.eu/ui/components/media-card): Video card: thumb, avatar, two-line title, meta and an overflow menu
- [Media row](https://omniaui.eu/ui/components/media-row): Compact horizontal media item for up-next lists and numbered playlists
- [Media thumb](https://omniaui.eu/ui/components/media-thumb): 16:9 video thumbnail with duration badge and watch-progress bar
- [Menubar](https://omniaui.eu/ui/components/menubar): Menubar: horizontal menu bar built from popover dropdown menus
- [Message](https://omniaui.eu/ui/components/message): Chat bubble: incoming and outgoing, sender, avatar, time, read receipt, hover actions, grouping, reply quote and date divider
- [Message thread](https://omniaui.eu/ui/components/message-thread): Scrolling conversation: header with subject, people, status and actions menu, messages that start at the bottom, composer and a sending overlay
- [Native select](https://omniaui.eu/ui/components/native-select): Native select: themed <select>; optional base-select picker styling
- [Navigation menu](https://omniaui.eu/ui/components/navmenu): Horizontal navigation links with optional dropdown children
- [Next teaser](https://omniaui.eu/ui/components/next-teaser): "Next product" teaser card with label, name, mark and an arrow tagline
- [Number input](https://omniaui.eu/ui/components/number-input): Number field with minus and plus step buttons
- [OTP input](https://omniaui.eu/ui/components/otp-input): One-time code field drawn as separate cells on a single real input
- [Page header](https://omniaui.eu/ui/components/page-header): Page title row with back link, subtitle, meta and actions; actions move under the title in narrow containers
- [Pagination](https://omniaui.eu/ui/components/pagination): Pagination
- [Password input](https://omniaui.eu/ui/components/password-input): Password field with show/hide button
- [Password requirements](https://omniaui.eu/ui/components/password-requirements): Live checklist of password rules under a password field
- [Phone input](https://omniaui.eu/ui/components/phone-input): Phone field with a country dial code select and the national number
- [Popover](https://omniaui.eu/ui/components/popover): Floating panel on popover + anchor positioning - no JavaScript
- [Price card](https://omniaui.eu/ui/components/price-card): Plan card with a monthly / yearly toggle (radio + :has), discount badge and included / excluded features
- [Product mark](https://omniaui.eu/ui/components/product-mark): Squircle app icon tile in the accent gradient (sm / lg / xl)
- [Progress](https://omniaui.eu/ui/components/progress): Progress bar
- [Project card](https://omniaui.eu/ui/components/project-card): Portfolio card with a browser-like preview, type badge, name, meta and an arrow link
- [Prose](https://omniaui.eu/ui/components/prose): Typography for long-form CMS, blog and help text: headings, lists, quotes, code, tables, figures
- [Radio group](https://omniaui.eu/ui/components/radio): Radio group: native inputs, stacked or row, descriptions, card style
- [Recovery codes](https://omniaui.eu/ui/components/recovery-codes): Warning panel with a code grid plus copy and download actions
- [Resizable](https://omniaui.eu/ui/components/resizable): Resizable panels using CSS resize (horizontal, vertical, free box)
- [Sample Block](https://omniaui.eu/ui/components/sample)
- [Scroll area](https://omniaui.eu/ui/components/scroll-area): Scroll area: bounded scroll region with themed thin scrollbar and edge shadows
- [Search field](https://omniaui.eu/ui/components/search): Search field with icon and shortcut hint on a native search input
- [Section block](https://omniaui.eu/ui/components/section-block)
- [Section header](https://omniaui.eu/ui/components/section-header)
- [Segmented control](https://omniaui.eu/ui/components/segmented): Radio group as a pill switcher for a single choice - no JavaScript
- [Separator](https://omniaui.eu/ui/components/separator): Separator: horizontal, vertical and with label
- [Severity card](https://omniaui.eu/ui/components/severity-card): Risk-colored expandable card (low, medium, high, critical) on details / summary - no JavaScript
- [Sheet](https://omniaui.eu/ui/components/sheet): Side panel on <dialog> (right, left, top, bottom) - no JavaScript
- [Showcase components](https://omniaui.eu/ui/components/showcase): Portfolio cards with a browser frame around the screenshot - for case studies and client work
- [Sidebar](https://omniaui.eu/ui/components/sidebar): Vertical navigation: header, groups, menu items, badges, nested menu, footer, icon-only mode
- [Site footer bar](https://omniaui.eu/ui/components/site-footer): Brand column with a short text, three link columns and a bottom bar
- [Site header](https://omniaui.eu/ui/components/site-header): Sticky header that turns into frosted glass once you scroll (scroll-driven animation) with a gradient call-to-action
- [Skeleton](https://omniaui.eu/ui/components/skeleton): Loading skeleton
- [Slider](https://omniaui.eu/ui/components/slider): Slider: native range input with themed track, fill and thumb
- [Sortable row](https://omniaui.eu/ui/components/sortable-row): Table row with a drag grip and drag / drop states (styling only)
- [Spinner](https://omniaui.eu/ui/components/spinner): Spinner: loading ring in sizes sm to xl, inherits currentColor
- [Stack card](https://omniaui.eu/ui/components/stack-card): Playlist or course cover drawn as a stacked deck with a count badge
- [Stack list](https://omniaui.eu/ui/components/stack-list): Technology pills for a product or project tech stack
- [Stat card](https://omniaui.eu/ui/components/stat-card): KPI tile with an icon tile, a big number, a label and an optional trend; tone modifiers and a clickable variant
- [Status dot](https://omniaui.eu/ui/components/status-dot): A small live state light for a job, agent, sync or server, with the state in text next to it
- [Stepper](https://omniaui.eu/ui/components/stepper): Wizard step navigation: done, active and upcoming steps (vertical or horizontal)
- [Table](https://omniaui.eu/ui/components/table): Data table: sortable header, selection, row actions, empty state, density modifiers
- [Table actions](https://omniaui.eu/ui/components/table-actions): Row actions as small icon buttons or as one overflow menu (popover) - no JavaScript
- [Table compact](https://omniaui.eu/ui/components/table-compact): Table variant: compact striped table without outer cell borders, for inside cards and side panels
- [Table of contents](https://omniaui.eu/ui/components/toc): "On this page" list with scroll-spy highlight, as used on the right of the docs
- [Tabs](https://omniaui.eu/ui/components/tabs): Tabs with radio inputs and :has() — no JavaScript
- [Tag input](https://omniaui.eu/ui/components/tag-input): Chips with remove buttons and a free-text input with suggestions
- [Terminal log](https://omniaui.eu/ui/components/terminal-log): Console window with traffic lights, level colors and a blinking cursor
- [Theme switch](https://omniaui.eu/ui/components/theme-switch): System / light / dark switch — CSS only (color-scheme + :has())
- [Theming](https://omniaui.eu/ui/components/theming)
- [Time input](https://omniaui.eu/ui/components/time-input): 24h time field (HH:mm) with suggested slots and an optional slot list
- [Timeline](https://omniaui.eu/ui/components/timeline): Vertical timeline with dated entries and an accent dot per item
- [Title bar](https://omniaui.eu/ui/components/titlebar): Draggable title bar for a frameless desktop window or widget, with a hairline once the body scrolls
- [Toast](https://omniaui.eu/ui/components/toast): Transient notifications (success, error, warning, info) with optional CSS auto-dismiss
- [Toast stack](https://omniaui.eu/ui/components/toast-stack): Toast stack: overlapping toasts that expand on hover or focus
- [Toggle and toggle group](https://omniaui.eu/ui/components/toggle): Toggle and toggle group: pressed state on checkbox/radio or aria-pressed
- [Toggle field](https://omniaui.eu/ui/components/toggle-field): Settings row with a title, a description and a switch
- [Tooltip](https://omniaui.eu/ui/components/tooltip): Tooltip (CSS only)
- [Top progress](https://omniaui.eu/ui/components/top-progress): Thin page-top loading bar on a native progress element (indeterminate or with a value)
- [Tree](https://omniaui.eu/ui/components/tree): Nested tree list on details / summary with a sticky action column - no JavaScript
- [Upgrade banner](https://omniaui.eu/ui/components/upgrade-banner): Soft callout for a free plan with limits, a usage meter and an upgrade action
- [User info](https://omniaui.eu/ui/components/user): Avatar with name and e-mail, truncating
- [Version banner](https://omniaui.eu/ui/components/version-banner): Small "new version available - reload" chip; the reload is a plain link to the current page
- [Watermark](https://omniaui.eu/ui/components/watermark): Light slanted text such as CONCEPT or DRAFT over an image, a card or a live frame

- [About with timeline](https://omniaui.eu/ui/blocks/about-timeline): About section: picture with a badge next to the company story and a year timeline
- [App header](https://omniaui.eu/ui/blocks/app-header): Top bar with sidebar toggle, module navigation and user actions
- [App shell](https://omniaui.eu/ui/blocks/app-shell): Application layout: sidebar, header bar, breadcrumb strip and scrolling content
- [Auth split](https://omniaui.eu/ui/blocks/auth-split): Sign-in with a brand panel (logo, quote) next to the form

- [Charts gallery (Pro)](https://omniaui.eu/ui/blocks/charts): Charts gallery. Nine chart cards in pure CSS and SVG: bar, line (one and two series), area, stacked area, donut, radial, horizontal bars and a sparkline.

- [Two-factor setup](https://omniaui.eu/ui/blocks/two-factor): Authenticator setup: QR, copyable key, OTP code and recovery codes
- [Watch layout (Pro)](https://omniaui.eu/ui/blocks/watch-layout): Video page: 16:9 player column with title, channel and description, plus an "Up next" list
- [Wizard dialog](https://omniaui.eu/ui/blocks/wizard-dialog): Modal wizard: stepper rail on the left, step content and navigation footer

## Pro blocks (license)

- calendar-01: Calendar 01: Single month. Card with one month and a selected day.
- calendar-02: Calendar 02: Two months with a range. Two adjacent months with a selected date range and a summary line.
- calendar-03: Calendar 03: Date and time slots. Booking layout: a month on the left, a list of time slots for the selected day on the right.
- calendar-04: Calendar 04: Presets. Calendar with quick presets (today, tomorrow, next week) as buttons below.
- calendar-05: Calendar 05: Date picker in a form. Form with a date-picker field (button trigger plus a calendar popover) and a native time input.
- charts: Charts gallery. Nine chart cards in pure CSS and SVG: bar, line (one and two series), area, stacked area, donut, radial, horizontal bars and a sparkline.
- dashboard-01: Dashboard 01: Sidebar, KPIs, chart and data table. Complete dashboard page: app shell with sidebar, KPI cards, an area chart card and a data table.
- dashboard-stats: KPI cards with label, value, trend and note
- hub-launcher: Grid of launcher cards for modules or settings sections
- login-04: Login 04: Form with image on the right. Reversed split layout: form on the left, image panel on the right, three social buttons.
- login-05: Login 05: Magic link, minimal. No card and no password: one e-mail field that sends a sign-in link, with a social fallback.
- onboarding-checklist: Setup card with progress and a checklist of actions
- otp-03: OTP 03: Four digits with back link. Four-digit PIN on a muted page, with a back link and a resend hint.
- settings-page: Section navigation next to stacked settings sections with rows and a danger zone
- sidebar-06: Sidebar 06: User footer with dropdown menu. The footer user opens an account menu (popover, no JavaScript).
- sidebar-07: Sidebar 07: Collapsible to icons. A checkbox and :has() collapse the sidebar to an icon rail. Click the panel icon in the bar.
- sidebar-08: Sidebar 08: Inset with secondary navigation. The page sits in a rounded inset card; the sidebar blends into the page background and carries a secondary nav.
- sidebar-09: Sidebar 09: Double sidebar (rail and panel). An icon rail selects the section; the second sidebar lists that section.
- sidebar-10: Sidebar 10: Team switcher header. A header button opens a popover menu to switch between workspaces.
- sidebar-11: Sidebar 11: File tree. Nested folders from details elements, using the submenu guide lines as tree lines.
- sidebar-12: Sidebar 12: Calendar sidebar. A date calendar and a calendar list inside the sidebar, for planner and agenda apps.
- sidebar-13: Sidebar 13: Sidebar in a dialog. A settings dialog with a sidebar for its sections; opens with invoker commands, no JavaScript.
- sidebar-14: Sidebar 14: Right sidebar. The sidebar sits on the right edge (oc-sidebar--right).
- sidebar-15: Sidebar 15: Left and right sidebars. Navigation on the left, an inspector panel on the right.
- sidebar-16: Sidebar 16: Sticky header. The bar stays pinned while the page content scrolls underneath.
- signup-03: Signup 03: Muted background with social buttons. Sign-up card on a muted page: social buttons, divider, e-mail form and legal line.
- status-page: Split 404 / 403 / 500 page: big status code panel next to a card with title, text, detail and actions
- watch-layout: Video page: 16:9 player column with title, channel and description, plus an "Up next" list
- form-builder: Admin form builder: field cards you can reorder, a palette of field types and a dialog per field
- masonry-gallery: Project gallery: masonry grid with captions, a CSS-only category filter and the lightbox
- media-manager: Admin media manager: documents, videos and photos of one item with upload, reorder, select and delete
- services-tabs: Services section: one tab per service with a hero image or video, text, key points and documents (no JavaScript)
- cms-dashboard: CMS admin home: dark sidebar with sections, top bar with page title and user, flash message, content tiles and recent changes
- chat-inbox: Split chat inbox: searchable conversation list with unread dots and the selected message thread with a composer
- infinite-carousel: Infinite carousel: after the last slide the first one slides in from the right, no rewind
- pricing-plans: License pricing as on omniaui.eu: launch offer, plans with a yearly/lifetime switch per card, a featured plan, VAT note and checkout help
- spotlight-cards: Spotlight cards: product cards whose glow and border light follow the mouse
- device-mockups: Device mockups: a laptop and a TV or LED wall around a live screen
- ecosystem-map: Ecosystem map: your logo on top, your apps per level, dotted flowing lines to what each app builds on
